query:
SELECT ($3 OR COALESCE(derived_access_profile($1, 'grant', 'kb_cogmaps', $2), false))
                  AND COALESCE(can_read_by_membership($1, 'kb_cogmaps', $2), false)
                  AND (NOT $4 OR COALESCE(can('kb_profiles', $1, 'write', 'kb_cogmaps', $2), false))
               AS "held!: bool"
